1.title: OLAP Operations Using Materialized Views and SQL Joins & Subqueries
1.aim: Perform OLAP operations using Materialized views and write SQL queries using Joins & Subqueries.

2.title: Star Schema OLAP Operations Using Materialized Views
2.aim: Perform OLAP operations by creating and using Materialized views based on a Star schema.

3.title: Horizontal and Vertical Bar Charts
3.aim: Write a Python program to Implement or create horizontal and vertical bar charts.

4.title: Grouped and Stacked Bar Charts
4.aim: Write a Python program to Implement or create grouped and stacked bar charts.

5.title: Histogram (Single and Multiple Variables)
5.aim: Write a Python program to implement histogram using single and multiple variable distribution.

6.title: Density Plot (Single and Multiple Variables)
6.aim: Write a Python program to implement density plot using single and multiple variable distribution.

7.title: Empirical Cumulative Distribution Function (ECDF)
7.aim: Write a Python program to implement an Empirical Cumulative Distribution Function (ECDF) plot.

8.title: Q-Q (Quantile-Quantile) Plot
8.aim: Write a Python program to implement a Q-Q (quantile-quantile) plot to compare two datasets.

9.title: Scatter Plot Using Sample Data
9.aim: Write a Python program to implement a Scatter Plot using sample data.

10.title: Sales Data Visualization Using Predefined Fields
10.aim: Using Power BI, perform sales data visualization using predefined fields.

11.title: Sales Calculation and Percentage Analysis Using Calculated Columns and DAX Measures
11.aim: Using Power BI, perform sales calculation and percentage analysis using calculated columns and DAX measures.

12.title: Conditional and Logical Analysis Using IF, AND, OR and Totals/Percentages
12.aim: Using Power BI, perform conditional and logical analysis using IF, AND, OR, and display totals and percentages using visualizations.
